title.quote: The Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence Directive (the “Directive”) sets out the requirements for the transparent, responsible and accountable use of AI.

issuing_body.quote: The Directive is a Management Board of Cabinet Directive, issued under the Management Board of Cabinet Act and effective December 1, 2024.

issuing_body.locator: 7.1 Treasury Board and Management Board of Cabinet
issuing_body.quote: approve this Directive and any changes to it

date_in_force.quote: The Directive is a Management Board of Cabinet Directive, issued under the Management Board of Cabinet Act and effective December 1, 2024.

status.quote: The Directive is a Management Board of Cabinet Directive, issued under the Management Board of Cabinet Act and effective December 1, 2024.

legal_force.quote: The Directive applies to all Ontario ministries and provincial agencies.
ministries must engage in AI risk management when seeking to use AI systems for a Government of Ontario use case.

judgment.status_reasoning: The Directive has been effective since 1 December 2024, which has passed; the page (updated 7 January 2026) shows no rescission or replacement. 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A binding sub-national directive specifically on government use of AI; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published and date_last_updated stay null: the text gives no approval or issue date, and the footer dates are not stated to be dates of the Directive or of an amendment.
